description: **Core** : Marwyn grows a +1/+1 counter for every other Elf that enters, so the plan is to flood the board with cheap Elves that double as mana and bodies.
**Engine** : Lords like Elvish Archdruid and Leaf-Crowned Visionary pump the whole team while Priest of Titania and Marwyn convert Elf count into huge mana.
**Payoff** : Spend the flood of mana on Ezuri-style overruns or a massive Marwyn tap to close out the game through combat.
win: **Ezuri overrun** : Activate Ezuri, Renegade Leader to give every Elf +3/+3 and trample, turning a wide board into a one-shot kill.
**Token swarm** : Imperious Perfect, Lys Alana Huntmaster and Elvish Warmaster generate enough Elf tokens to overwhelm blockers.
**Mana dump** : A giant Marwyn tap fuels game-ending spells or a lethal commander damage swing.

description: **Core** : Marwyn's own counter engine is the plan's backbone — every Elf that enters stacks a +1/+1 counter on her.
**Engine** : Immaculate Magistrate dumps counters equal to your Elf count while token makers keep triggering Marwyn's growth ability.
**Payoff** : A counter-fat Marwyn taps for enormous mana or swings for lethal commander damage.
win: **Giant Marwyn** : A heavily-countered Marwyn taps for a mountain of green mana or attacks for lethal commander damage.
**Counter snowball** : Doublers like Gilder Bairn and pump effects turn each counter into exponential board growth.
**Powered pump** : Raggadragga and counter-based payoffs convert accumulated counters into a game-ending attack.

description: **Core** : Marwyn's tap ability scales with her power, so the plan is to untap her repeatedly for infinite or near-infinite mana.
**Engine** : Untap outlets — Staff of Domination, Umbral Mantle, Quirion Ranger and Wirewood Symbiote — recycle her taps.
**Payoff** : Turn infinite mana into draws, damage or endless creatures to win on the spot.
win: **Staff loop** : With a 5+ power Marwyn, Staff of Domination untaps her for {3} and draws a card for {5}, chaining into your whole deck.
**Umbral Mantle** : Equip for free and pay {3} to untap Marwyn with +2/+2, netting mana every loop for infinite green.
**Untap loops** : Ashaya plus Scryb Ranger, or Temur Sabertooth plus untappers and Witness recursion, generate infinite mana into a finisher.

description: **Core** : Marwyn is a mana dork whose output equals her power, so the plan maximizes mana per Elf and per land.
**Engine** : Priest of Titania, Elvish Archdruid, Quirion Ranger and Wirewood Lodge multiply your mana several times over.
**Payoff** : Race to enormous mana and cast game-ending spells far ahead of the curve.
win: **Big-mana spells** : Cast huge payoffs like Wurmcalling, Akroma's Memorial or a massive Fanning the Flames earlier than anyone else.
**Super-tap** : Untapping a fat Marwyn multiple times in one turn produces dozens of green mana.
**Dork swarm** : With several Elf dorks each tapping for multiple mana, no other deck can match your ramp.

description: **Core** : Elves are cheap and numerous, so the plan is attacking early while Marwyn grows with every Elf that enters.
**Engine** : Elvish Warmaster and Lys Alana Huntmaster create tokens that trigger Marwyn and swell the attacking army.
**Payoff** : Ezuri's +3/+3 trample activation and lord bonuses turn a wide Elf board into lethal swings.
win: **Early pressure** : Curving one-drops into lords like Imperious Perfect and Leaf-Crowned Visionary piles on fast damage.
**Overrun** : Ezuri's pump or Elvish Warmaster's +2/+2 deathtouch activation breaks through stalled boards.
**Haste wave** : Concordant Crossroads and Battlemage's Bracers let the Elf army attack the turn it arrives.

Engines: Elvish Archdruid
**Elfball lord and dork** : It pumps every other Elf with +1/+1 and taps for one green per Elf you control, doubling as both a lord and a second Marwyn-style mana engine.
Priest of Titania
**Per-Elf mana** : The classic Elfball dork taps for one green for each Elf on the battlefield, scaling your mana with the board and fueling Marwyn's growth.
Leaf-Crowned Visionary
**Lord with draw** : It buffs other Elves and lets you pay one green to draw whenever you cast an Elf spell, keeping the Elf train rolling with cards.
Imperious Perfect
**Token lord** : It gives other Elves +1/+1 and creates a 1/1 Elf Warrior for one green, churning out Elves that trigger Marwyn's counter ability.
Ezuri, Renegade Leader
**Elf general** : It regenerates any Elf for one green and can pump the whole team +3/+3 with trample, acting as both protector and finisher.
Elvish Warmaster
**Token swarm and overrun** : It spawns an Elf token whenever other Elves enter and later gives all Elves +2/+2 and deathtouch, a built-in finisher.
Lys Alana Huntmaster
**Free tokens** : Every Elf spell you cast makes a free 1/1 Elf Warrior, snowballing the board and stacking counters on Marwyn.
Elvish Visionary
**Cantrip Elf** : It draws a card on entry while also counting as an Elf for Marwyn's trigger and your mana dorks.
Immaculate Magistrate
**Counter dump** : It taps to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature for each Elf you control, making Marwyn enormous in a single activation.
Ashaya, Soul of the Wild
**Creature-lands** : It turns your nontoken creatures into Forests, so every Elf also counts as a land — fueling land-based untap loops and letting dorks untap like lands.
Wirewood Symbiote
**Bounce untapper** : Returning an Elf to hand untaps any creature, letting you reuse Marwyn's tap and re-cast Elves for extra counters.
Quirion Ranger
**Free untap** : Bouncing a Forest untaps a creature for free once a turn, effectively doubling Marwyn's taps every turn.
Seeker of Skybreak
**Untap dork** : A one-mana Elf that untaps any target creature, letting Marwyn tap twice or more per turn cycle.
Hope Tender
**Land untapper** : It untaps one land for one mana — or two when exerted — keeping your mana open while Marwyn does the heavy lifting.
Magus of the Candelabra
**X untap** : Paying X and tapping it untaps X lands, a scaling untap engine that converts Marwyn's mana into more mana.
Ioreth of the Healing House
**Legendary untapper** : It untaps any permanent or two legendary creatures, doubling up Marwyn's taps in a single turn.
Derevi, Empyrial Tactician
**Combat untapper** : Whenever a creature deals combat damage, Derevi taps or untaps a permanent — untapping Marwyn every combat step for free.
Temur Sabertooth
**Bounce engine** : For one green it bounces another creature to hand and becomes indestructible, reusing entry triggers and looping untap spells.
Woodcaller Automaton
**Prototype untapper** : Cast for its prototype cost it untaps a land and turns it into a haste creature, adding a body and mana back at once.
Emiel the Blessed
**Blink engine** : For three mana it exiles and returns a creature you control, re-triggering Elves' entry abilities — including Marwyn's counter growth.
Tolarian Kraken
**Draw-trigger untapper** : Whenever you draw a card it can pay one mana to tap or untap a creature, turning draw spells into Marwyn untaps.
Locust Swarm
**Self-untapper** : It untaps itself for one green each turn and can regenerate, a cheap repeatable untap outlet for your mana.
Raggadragga, Goreguts Boss

CardAdvantage: **Draw engine** : It draws three cards a turn and can return itself to hand, turning Marwyn's mana into massive card advantage.

**X untap artifact** : Paying X and tapping it untaps X lands, turning Marwyn's big taps into a fully untapped mana base.

Engines: ⚙️ Engines / Synergies

Ramp: Dorks, untap lands and mana artifacts that multiply green production ahead of Marwyn's own output.

Untap auras, bounce loops and mana-multiplying pieces that turn Marwyn's big tap into infinite mana and a win.

quick_read: **Mana engine** : Marwyn taps for green equal to her power, so every Elf that enters makes her a bigger mana dork.
**Elfball core** : Lords and token makers like Elvish Archdruid, Imperious Perfect and Elvish Warmaster flood the board while growing Marwyn.
**Combo-ready** : Untap pieces — Staff of Domination, Umbral Mantle, Quirion Ranger — turn her big taps into infinite mana.
**Win plan** : Ezuri's trample overrun or a huge Marwyn activation closes games once the mana engine spins up.
primer.combos_note: Marwyn is a combo mana engine — Staff of Domination or Umbral Mantle turn a 5+ power Marwyn into infinite mana, draws and life; Ashaya plus Scryb Ranger or Quirion Ranger loop, Temur Sabertooth plus untap creatures with Witness recursion, and untap-spell lines (Vitalize, Mobilize, Emerald Charm) round out a package of roughly 20 known combos.
primer.source_html:
• EDHREC : Marwyn's page frames her as a mono-green Elfball commander whose decks lean on Elf mana dorks, untap effects and Ezuri-style overruns, with Elvish Archdruid and Priest of Titania as her most-played companions.
  • Community knowledge : Marwyn is widely known as a big-mana commander where the fastest decks combo off with Staff of Domination or Umbral Mantle as soon as she reaches 5+ power.
  • Primer wisdom : Deckbuilders emphasize playing cheap Elves first — every one-drop is a counter on Marwyn and a step toward a game-winning tap.
  • Budget guidance : The deck is famously budget-friendly: dork-heavy Elfball shells run on commons and uncommons, with pricier pieces like Staff of Domination as optional upgrades.

Elvish Archdruid.Elves: **Lord and dork** : In the Elfball plan Elvish Archdruid is the double-duty star — it pumps the whole Elf team with +1/+1 and taps for one green per Elf, feeding both the board and Marwyn's mana total.
Elvish Archdruid.+1/+1 Counters: **Counter-enabler** : The lord bonus stacks with Marwyn's own growth so every Elf hits a little harder, while its Elf-count tap ability funds the steady stream of spells that keep counters flowing.
Elvish Archdruid.Combo: **Mana multiplier** : In combo builds the Archdruid's per-Elf tap provides a second source of large mana alongside Marwyn, letting untap loops go infinite even before Marwyn herself is huge.
Elvish Archdruid.Ramp: **Ramp lord** : The Archdruid turns each Elf into a mana source, so in the Ramp plan it converts the growing Elf population into steadily accelerating mana.
Elvish Archdruid.Aggro: **Team pump** : The +1/+1 for all other Elves is exactly what an aggressive Elf army wants, and its mana ability keeps the curve moving while you swing.

Priest of Titania.Elves: **Mana dork core** : Priest of Titania taps for one green per Elf on the battlefield, the classic Elfball engine that pairs perfectly with Marwyn's own Elf-count growth.
Priest of Titania.+1/+1 Counters: **Counter fuel** : The Priest's Elf-based mana pays for the Elf spells that put counters on Marwyn, accelerating the snowball every turn.
Priest of Titania.Combo: **Second engine** : Once the board fills with Elves, the Priest's tap output matches Marwyn's, giving untap loops a redundant mana engine that is easy to tutor into.
Priest of Titania.Ramp: **Per-Elf ramp** : Every Elf on the battlefield adds one mana to the Priest, so the Ramp plan's production scales with the board.
Priest of Titania.Aggro: **Cheap acceleration** : A turn-two Priest lets you cast two more Elves on turn three, turbocharging both the aggressive curve and Marwyn's counter growth.

Leaf-Crowned Visionary.Elves: **Lord and draw** : Leaf-Crowned Visionary buffs other Elves and draws a card whenever you cast an Elf spell, keeping the Elfball's hand and board full at once.
Leaf-Crowned Visionary.+1/+1 Counters: **Value lord** : The +1/+1 lord bonus makes counter-carrying Elves hit harder, while the pay-one-green draw restocks the spells that grow Marwyn.
Leaf-Crowned Visionary.Combo: **Combo draw** : In the Combo plan the Visionary is a draw engine that turns each Elf cast — including your combo pieces — into an extra card for one green.
Leaf-Crowned Visionary.Ramp: **Draw while ramping** : The Ramp plan loves cheap draw attached to an Elf body, converting each Elf spell into a card without slowing mana growth.
Leaf-Crowned Visionary.Aggro: **Pump and refill** : The lord bonus boosts the attacking team and the cast-trigger draw keeps aggression fueled through the mid-game.

Imperious Perfect.Elves: **Lord and token maker** : Imperious Perfect both pumps other Elves and creates a 1/1 Elf Warrior for one green — the classic Elfball generator that also grows Marwyn.
Imperious Perfect.+1/+1 Counters: **Token triggers** : Each token made by the Perfect enters as an Elf, triggering Marwyn's counter ability and stacking more +1/+1 counters.
Imperious Perfect.Ramp: **Board-based ramp** : Its tokens become mana through Priest of Titania and Elvish Archdruid, so the Perfect quietly multiplies the Ramp plan's output.
Imperious Perfect.Aggro: **Swarm builder** : A repeatable token maker with a lord bonus is exactly what an aggressive Elf deck needs to flood the board and swing wide.

Ezuri, Renegade Leader.Elves: **Elf general** : Ezuri protects any Elf with regeneration for one green and turns the whole Elf team into a trampling finisher with its overrun-style activation.
Ezuri, Renegade Leader.+1/+1 Counters: **Counter payoff** : Ezuri's +3/+3 and trample activation makes every accumulated counter count double when the Elf army goes lethal.
Ezuri, Renegade Leader.Combo: **Finisher and shield** : In combo builds Ezuri is the cleanup crew — regenerate a key piece, then spend leftover infinite mana to give the team +3/+3 and trample.
Ezuri, Renegade Leader.Ramp: **Mana sink** : Once the Ramp plan is flooding mana, Ezuri converts that mana directly into a board-wide trample win.
Ezuri, Renegade Leader.Aggro: **Overrun** : Ezuri is the Aggro plan's kill button: +3/+3 and trample for all Elves turns a wide board into a one-shot attack.

Lys Alana Huntmaster.Elves: **Token engine** : Every Elf spell you cast makes a free 1/1 Elf Warrior, snowballing the board and triggering Marwyn's growth with each token.
Lys Alana Huntmaster.+1/+1 Counters: **Counter generator** : Each token from Lys Alana enters as an Elf, putting another +1/+1 counter on Marwyn for every Elf spell cast.
Lys Alana Huntmaster.Ramp: **Board multiplier** : Free Elf tokens become extra mana through the Ramp plan's Elf-tapping dorks, effectively ramping with every Elf spell.
Lys Alana Huntmaster.Aggro: **Army printer** : Lys Alana's free tokens swell the attacking army and keep the board wide enough for Ezuri-style overruns.

Elvish Warmaster.Elves: **Token lord** : Elvish Warmaster makes an Elf token whenever other Elves enter and can later give the whole team +2/+2 with deathtouch.
Elvish Warmaster.+1/+1 Counters: **Trigger storm** : Warmaster's entry trigger stacks with Marwyn's, so every Elf entering both grows Marwyn and adds to the token army.
Elvish Warmaster.Ramp: **Token ramp source** : Each token is another Elf for Priest of Titania and Elvish Archdruid, growing the Ramp plan's mana with every entry trigger.
Elvish Warmaster.Aggro: **Finisher ability** : Its mass activation gives Elves +2/+2 and deathtouch, a devastating mid-combat finisher for the aggressive plan.

Wirewood Lodge.Elves: **Untap land** : Wirewood Lodge taps for colorless and spends one green to untap any Elf — Marwyn first — effectively doubling her taps every turn.
Wirewood Lodge.+1/+1 Counters: **Double activation** : Untapping a counter-carrying Marwyn lets her tap twice per turn, doubling the mana each counter provides.
Wirewood Lodge.Combo: **Combo untapper** : In combo builds the Lodge's untap ability is a free repeatable untap for Marwyn that slots straight into infinite-mana loops.
Wirewood Lodge.Ramp: **Extra engine** : The Ramp plan uses the Lodge to untap Marwyn or Priest of Titania for a second tap, adding a whole mana engine's worth of output.
Wirewood Lodge.Aggro: **Repeat taps** : Untapping Marwyn or a dork after combat keeps the aggressive curve fed while the Elves swing.

Reclamation Sage.Elves: **Elf removal** : A three-mana Elf that destroys an artifact or enchantment on entry — interaction that also grows Marwyn and counts as an Elf.
Reclamation Sage.+1/+1 Counters: **Counter and answer** : The Sage both triggers Marwyn's counter ability and answers the artifacts and enchantments that threaten your counter plan.
Reclamation Sage.Ramp: **Flexible removal** : The Ramp plan keeps mana open anyway, so the Sage's on-entry removal fits without slowing the ramp curve.
Reclamation Sage.Aggro: **Protection** : Clearing a Ghostly Prison-style roadblock lets the aggressive Elf army keep attacking.

Elvish Visionary.Elves: **Cantrip Elf** : Elvish Visionary draws a card when it enters, replacing itself while triggering Marwyn and every other Elf-enters ability.
Elvish Visionary.Combo: **Combo fuel** : In combo builds the Visionary is cheap Elf-draw that digs for combo pieces while adding a counter to Marwyn.

Wirewood Symbiote.Combo: **Bounce untapper** : Returning an Elf to hand untaps any creature, letting you reuse Marwyn's tap repeatedly while re-casting Elves for more counters.
Wirewood Symbiote.Aggro: **Evasion trick** : The Symbiote re-casts cheap Elves to retrigger Marwyn's growth and can untap a key attacker after blocks.

Quirion Ranger.Combo: **Free untap** : Returning a Forest to hand untaps Marwyn for free once a turn — an essential piece of the deck's infinite-mana lines.
Quirion Ranger.Ramp: **Double dork** : Quirion Ranger untaps Marwyn or another dork for one Forest bounce, effectively doubling your ramp for the turn.
